textInfo.description: The quintessential manual of Bhairava contemplation. Features 112 practical experiential doorways (Dhāraṇās) to dissolve the illusion of separation using breath, sound, everyday gaps, emotions, void, and pure attention.

verses.devanagari: यथा सम्यगहं वेद्मि तथा मे ब्रूहि भैरव श्रीभैरव उवाच ऊर्ध्वे प्राणो ह्यधो जीवो विसर्गात्मा परोच्चरेत् उत्पत्तिद्वितयस्थाने भरणाद्भरिता स्थितिः ॥ 24 ॥
verses.studyGloss: Directing attention to the two spaces where the incoming breath dissolves and where the outgoing breath emerges, by centering awareness in the gap between them, the radiant form of Bhairava is revealed.
verses.practicalContext: Dhāraṇā 1: The quintessential meditation on the gap between breaths (Madhya / Dvādaśānta). The bedrock of Trika breath contemplation.

provenance.editionNotes: Canonical Devanagari edition from Kashmir Shaiva Rudrayāmala collection.

verses.devanagari: मरुतोऽन्तर्बहिर्वापि वियद्युग्मानिवर्तनात् भैरव्या भैरवस्येत्थं भैरवि व्यज्यते वपुः ॥ 25 ॥
verses.studyGloss: When the breath moves neither in nor out, resting motionless in the Center, through this effortless stillness, Consciousness blossoms into illumination.
verses.practicalContext: Dhāraṇā 2: Dissolving breath fluctuation into the motionless central gap.

provenance.editionNotes: Canonical Devanagari edition from Kashmir Shaiva Rudrayāmala collection.

verses.devanagari: न व्रजेन्न विशेच्छक्तिर्मरुद्रूपा विकासिते निर्विकल्पतया मध्ये तया भैरवरूपता ॥ 26 ॥

verses.practicalContext: Canonical contemplation verse from Vijñāna Bhairava Tantra.

verses.studyGloss: Severing all mental conceptions, fixing awareness on no object whatsoever, one directly enters the thought-free, unstirred essence of Bhairava.
verses.practicalContext: Dhāraṇā 9: Pure Śāmbhavopāya; resting directly in Nirvikalpa awareness by instantly dropping cognitive elaboration.

provenance.editionNotes: Canonical Devanagari edition from Kashmir Shaiva Rudrayāmala collection.

verses.practicalContext: Canonical contemplation verse from Vijñāna Bhairava Tantra.

verses.practicalContext: Canonical contemplation verse from Vijñāna Bhairava Tantra.

verses.practicalContext: Canonical contemplation verse from Vijñāna Bhairava Tantra.

verses.practicalContext: Canonical contemplation verse from Vijñāna Bhairava Tantra.

verses.practicalContext: Dhāraṇā 15: Nāda-yoga contemplation using the tail-end of acoustic resonance as a springboard into transcendence.

verses.practicalContext: Canonical contemplation verse from Vijñāna Bhairava Tantra.

verses.practicalContext: Canonical contemplation verse from Vijñāna Bhairava Tantra.
